sentences.en: They are dancing, intoxicated with the beauty of cherry blossoms.
sentences.zh: 他们陶醉在樱花的美丽中翩翩起舞。

sentences.en: There are cherry trees on each side of the street.
sentences.zh: 街道两旁种满了樱桃树。

sentences.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像是由樱桃木雕刻而成的。

phrases.zh: 下樱桃（这里可能是表达错误或地方方言，直译为“下樱桃”不太通顺）
